raw_text:
Independent review of run r-20260926T214404611968-s17-catalog-retry-one-budget at head 5ce4cc816eb69f19e8cde3edaf7451d7516929d4 against base 82592e02bda87acfd2c38f73980185295f57b77c. The node repairs the four findings of the review of r-20260926T205138354076: a per-origin catalog deadline, unvalidated scaling overrides, missing non-HTTP/timeout coverage, and a forbidden plan-version edit.

Goal fidelity. The change gives fetch_catalog a single module-level CATALOG_RETRY_DEADLINE and routes every catalog read through it: the legacy global origin, every engine origin and every routing origin all pass through cached_catalog, and the only remaining construction of a deadline is the module-level line evaluated once per launch. The two scaling overrides are validated as finite and positive with the bound capped at 900 and a refusal that names the variable, and the refused-override set is exercised by ten parametrized cases. Coverage now reaches refused connections, reset connections, a timeout that must not wait, a two-absent-origin endpoint-document launch, and the overrides.

Independent verification. I re-ran the declared gate at the reviewed head: 40 passed in 37.3 s, 0 failures, with the log header naming the revision, tree, cwd, command and the resolved module.__file__ inside the reviewed worktree, and whole-tree Ruff was green in the source receipt. I then falsified the guard myself. Running the reviewed two-absent-origins test against the base revision makes it fail at 'two absent origins spent more than the 4 s budget: 8.2s' (8.55 s run), while the same test against the reviewed head passes in 4.23 s; the A/B required --import-mode=importlib, because tests/ carries __init__.py and pytest's default prepend mode put the reviewed tree ahead of PYTHONPATH, silently testing the wrong module on the first attempt. The override hazard was shown directly against a bound-and-not-listening origin: at the base revision CLIVE_CATALOG_RETRY_BOUND=inf leaves the launcher still running after a 10 s cap, while at the reviewed head it exits 2 in 0.10 s with 'clive: CLIVE_CATALOG_RETRY_BOUND must be a finite positive number of seconds'. The base-arm scratch module is byte-identical to 82592e02:imas_ambix/agent/clive.py (sha256 dc97b3337...), and the negative control's restoration is confirmed (sha256 bfeaaa8dd24619a5... at both the source commit and the worktree).

Scope and records. Exactly four declared paths changed, the target worktree is clean at the reviewed head, plan-version and plan-modified are byte-identical at base and head (125 and 2026-09-26) as instructed, and the manifest's claims check out against the artifacts. Two minor findings: the evidence anchor misspells the host as 98d4-clu-2058, and the budget guard's wall-clock margin is thin enough that a loaded machine could flake it. Two manifest shape inconsistencies are recorded without affecting the verdict. Three pre-existing failures and one non-terminating neighbouring test in tests/test_agent_endpoint_discovery.py are recorded as follow-ons: they reproduce identically at base and head and the change does not touch the modules involved.

VERDICT done_when: declared gate re-run green at the head by this review, the guard shown red against the true base revision, and the override hazard demonstrated with a bounded probe.
VERDICT write_paths: the four declared paths only, plan metadata byte untouched.
VERDICT manifest: complete and recognised, with two shape inconsistencies and a host typo in its evidence anchor.
VERDICT diff: both commits read in full; source and records are coherent and bound to each other.
